# Ready-made ComfyUI node packs (scripts/install_h3_h200_overlay.sh, pinned clones):
#   ComfyUI-KJNodes d3cfe216 (GPL-3.0)          ColorMatch; MiniMax H3 nodes for later A/B
#   ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite 4d907bee (GPL-3.0) VHS_LoadVideo / VHS_VideoCombine / frame select
#   ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation 26545cc2 (MIT)  RIFE VFI (rife417.pth, SHA-256 in the installer)
#
# Installed with `pip install --no-deps -r` into the ComfyUI venv AFTER h3_comfy_venv_isolate, so
# pip never touches torch 2.11.0+cu128, numpy 2.5.3 or opencv-contrib-python-headless 4.13.0.92.
# The list is complete (transitive closure resolved against the isolated venv); `pip check` after
# the install must stay clean.
#
# Deliberately NOT installed (upstream requirements.txt asks for them):
#   opencv-python (VHS), opencv-python-headless (KJNodes), opencv-contrib-python (Frame-Interpolation):
#       cv2 already comes from opencv-contrib-python-headless; a second cv2 wheel would shadow it.
#   imageio-ffmpeg (VHS): optional bundled ffmpeg; the installer puts system ffmpeg on PATH.
#   mss (KJNodes): screen-capture node only.
#   cupy / taichi (Frame-Interpolation): only for GMFSS/softsplat models; RIFE is pure torch.
# Frame-Interpolation's own needs (einops, kornia, scipy, pillow, torchvision, tqdm, pyyaml) are
# already pinned in comfy-venv-requirements.txt / deploy/live-lock/venv.txt.
